selected_paper.title: Modeling and Control for UAV with Off-center Slung Load
selected_paper.publication_status: arXiv preprint; primary full text reviewed
selected_paper.original_plant: single multirotor with off-center suspension point and slung load
selected_paper.original_method: cascade control with suspension-point acceleration regulating swing angle, off-center attitude control, and load-velocity outer loop
selected_paper.selection_reason: The suspension-point-acceleration-to-swing-control idea and cascade separation remain meaningful on the frozen five-link plant without requiring slack cable, camera FoV, obstacle, or multi-vehicle interfaces.
